title: Design: Modern part sale without a vehicle prints only Service For and the name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A and customer B, so the case has a customer and a different payer.
  • Have a new open part sale for this test for customer B with no vehicle, billed to customer A, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Set the document design to modern (Settings, invoice and estimate design).
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p4-14-after-modern.png, bt-p4-13-before-modern.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the part sale.
  2. Click the print icon on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Finance tab shows the part sale document.

Step 2:

  • The band reads only "SERVICE FOR" and customer B's name, with no separator after the name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12310 (Story 8, "Service For" band on invoices and estimates)

  • S8-R4: “On a part sale with a vehicle attached, the band adds the unit as in S8-R2 and S8-R3; without a vehicle it prints only "SERVICE FOR" and the name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "4 Service For band on invoices and estimates", pictures "Modern" (This build), "Modern" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).
